freeze_order: Written before reading or computing per-run boundary-support scores; no perturbations generated and no new simulations run.
allowed_sources: Only the two previously frozen R0C sources in each House; no relocation.
allowed_winds: Only the two previously frozen wind contexts in each House.
realizations: All four existing realizations for each source/wind/gas cell.
dominant_outflow_rule: Select the signed horizontal axis with the largest absolute component of the time-and-realization mean plume-weighted baseline wind. Use the same side for all four realizations in a cell. A zero mean vector makes the case ineligible.
acceptance: All four realizations must pass mean and q95 edge-mass thresholds and minimum centroid clearance. Require finite nonnegative footprint, positive total footprint mass, and a valid equal-height source lineage. Downwind source clearance must itself exceed three footprint bins.
selection: Prefer the first eligible source/wind in each House in wind-label/source-index lexical order. If one House has no eligible source, use the first two eligible cases in the other House. Choose at most two cases; no outcome-based optimization.
rationale: At most five percent mean edge-supported footprint mass and ten percent upper-tail edge mass, with a full boundary-band centroid margin, conservatively screen the finite-domain confound. These are eligibility controls, not estimated physical lost-mass measurements.
no_eligible_case: Report W0C_STAGE0_NO_CLEAN_BASE_HOLD. Run zero perturbation simulations. Do not loosen thresholds, relocate sources, add seeds/Houses, or claim W0C_GLOBAL_ERROR_SUFFICIENT_STOP.
one_eligible_case: Permit only a bounded one-case experiment with a maximum PARTIAL_HOLD conclusion; it cannot close the replication requirement.
scientific_stop_preservation: R0C1, R0D and P0 verdicts remain in force; this is a separately authorized causal gate.
